name: Face Blend Boundary
algorithm: Face Blend Boundary — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method detects face blending boundaries for deepfake detection:

1. **블렌딩경계Localization**: The boundary where a generated/swapped face meets the original video is detected. This is typically an oval or irregular contour around the face where alpha blending, Poisson blending, or feathered compositing was applied. The boundary is localized using gradient analysis and texture transition detection.

2. **경계기울기분석**: At the blending boundary, the method measures gradient profiles perpendicular to the boundary. Natural skin-to-hair/neck transitions show anatomically motivated gradients. Artificial blending creates characteristic smooth transition zones with unnatural gradient profiles — too uniform or too symmetrical compared to natural boundaries.

3. **색상Discontinuity감지**: Even with sophisticated blending (Poisson editing), subtle color discontinuities persist at the boundary. The method detects these by analyzing color channel differences across the boundary in multiple color spaces (RGB, Lab, YCbCr). The CIE ΔE color difference is computed across the boundary.

4. **텍스처주파수Mismatch**: The spatial frequency content (texture) on either side of the blending boundary is compared. Generated face texture (inside the boundary) often differs from original footage texture (outside) — different noise characteristics, sharpness, or compression artifacts. This frequency mismatch is detectable even when color blending is well-executed.

5. **시간적경계안정성**: The blending boundary position and width should remain consistent relative to the face across frames. The method tracks boundary characteristics over time — unstable or shifting boundary artifacts indicate per-frame independent face generation with inconsistent blending, yielding elevated forensic scores.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through face blend boundary analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
